projectCheck.command: pnpm check; node scripts/check-all.mjs; node --test scripts/deploy.test.mjs
projectCheck.note: Ten builds/site checks, zero Astro diagnostics, nine regression tests, five deploy-guard tests. Browser viewport checks at 390/768/1440 show no horizontal overflow, including release and beta pages after shared-chrome consolidation. Reduced motion checked in source; no full assistive-technology or measured performance certification.
